Nasadenie doplnku Rewora Product Reviews: Installing the Rewora Product Reviews app on Shopify
Od inštalácie z Shopify App Store cez ak: From installing it in the Shopify App Store, through activating the widget in your theme, to approving the first review. You can do the whole rollout yourself, without touching the theme code.
Celé nasadenie krok za krokom — od inšta: The whole rollout step by step — from installing the app to an approved review on the product page.
V Shopify admine choď do Apps → Shopify: In the Shopify admin go to Apps → Shopify App Store (or straight to apps.shopify.com).
Do vyhľadávania napíš rewora a otvor Rew: Search for rewora and open Rewora Product Reviews ($4.99/month, 7-day free trial).
Zobrazí sa okno Install app so zoznamom: An Install app window appears listing the permissions the app needs. Confirm with Install.
Otvorí sa obrazovka Select a plan → prep: The Select a plan screen opens with a Pay monthly / Pay yearly switch. The Standard plan costs $4.99 / 30 days or $49.99 / year ($9 cheaper), with 7 days free. Click Select.
Na obrazovke Approve charge skontroluj p: On the Approve charge screen check the plan and click Approve.
Ak ti Shopify hlási „You don’t have any: If Shopify says “You don’t have any payment methods on file”, add a payment method first via Go to billing settings — otherwise Approve cannot be completed.
Aktivácia app embed v šablóne: Activating the app embed in your theme
Po inštalácii sa otvorí úvodná stránka a: After installation the app's start page opens: Rewora → Reviews.
V bloku 1. Activate app embed klikni na: In the 1. Activate app embed block click Activate App Embed. The theme editor opens with the App embeds panel.
Prepínač pri Rewora – Rewora Product Rev: Switch Rewora – Rewora Product Reviews on and click Save in the top right.
Vloženie widgetu na stránku produktu: Adding the widget to the product page
Vráť sa do appky a v bloku 2. Add widget: Go back to the app and in the 2. Add widget to your page block click Add to the page.
V editore témy sa v šablóne Default prod: A Product Reviews block is added to the Default product template in the theme editor. Drag it wherever you want it.
V ľavom paneli si nastav vzhľad widgetu,: In the left panel set the widget's look so it matches your brand:
Main colors – Text color, Text small col: Main colors – Text color, Text small color, Text caption color, Background color, Border color
Action – Text on action color, Action co: Action – Text on action color, Action color, Action hover color (the Write a review button)
Feedback colors – Positive / Negative co: Feedback colors – Positive / Negative color and their backgrounds
Other – Stars color, Empty stars color,: Other – Stars color, Empty stars color, Delete icon color, Modal background, Avatar background
Klikni Save. Na stránke produktu sa obja: Click Save. A Reviews and Ratings section with 1–5 star filters appears on the product page.
Ako zákazník pridá recenziu: How a customer adds a review
Na stránke produktu klikne Write a revie: On the product page they click Write a review and fill in the form:
Positives & Negatives – ľubovoľný počet: Positives & Negatives – any number of pros and cons
Images & Videos – až 5 obrázkov (JPG, JP: Images & Videos – up to 5 images (JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, max. 10 MB) and a video (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WEBM, max. 40 MB)
Your name – ak nechá prázdne, recenzia j: Your name – left empty, the review stays anonymous
Your email – povinný, nezverejňuje sa, s: Your email – required, never published, used only for verification
Zaškrtne súhlas s Terms & Conditions a P: They tick the Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy consent and hit Send
Recenziu vie zákazník dostať aj automati: Customers can also be asked for a review automatically by e-mail after a purchase — the number of days after the order and the sender address are set in Settings in the app. The same place lets you turn on review imports from Heureka.sk, Heureka.cz and Arukereso (an account key is required).
V Shopify admine choď do Apps → Rewora P: In the Shopify admin go to Apps → Rewora Product Reviews → Reviews Management.
Zoznam má záložky All / Not approved / A: The list has All / Not approved / Approved tabs and the columns Title, Product name, Review text, Rating source, Rating, Is approved, Reviewed at. A new review has Is approved = No and is not visible in the store yet.
Schváliť sa dá dvoma spôsobmi:: There are two ways to approve it:
Hromadne: zaškrtni checkbox pri recenzii: In bulk: tick the checkbox next to the review → Approve / Reject appears above the list → click Approve.
Cez detail: klikni na názov recenzie. Uv: From the detail: click the review title. You see the Summary text, Pros, Cons and an Info panel (product, rating, source, date) with an approve/reject button.
Po schválení sa stĺpec prepne na Is appr: Once approved the column switches to Is approved = Yes, the detail gains an Approved at timestamp and the button turns into a red Reject (approval can be undone at any time).
Skontroluj výsledok na e-shope — na strá: Check the result in the store — the product page now shows the average rating (e.g. 5.0, 1 review), the 1–5 star breakdown, the author's name, the date, the text, pros and cons, any attached photo and Was this helpful? / Report.
Widget sa nezobrazí, ak nie je zapnutý a: The widget will not show if the app embed is off, or if you did not click Save in the theme editor after adding the block. And a review only appears in the store once approved — until then it stays in Reviews Management.
